title: MAP-LOC-bramble-union-villages - Bramble Union Villages Location Map

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The forest opens into hidden homes: thorn-warren shelters, cook-fires, moss lamps, patched tools, and people who go very quiet when strangers arrive. Whatever happened on the road, this place is not a camp of raiders. It is a community trying not to disappear.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: The forest opens into hidden homes: thorn-warren shelters, cook-fires, moss lamps, patched tools, and people who go very quiet when strangers arrive. Whatever happened on the road, this place is not a camp of raiders. It is a community trying not to disappear.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Use this optional discovery map only after mercy or trust opens the route; make the opposition human without excusing the ambush.

sections.title: GM notes
items: This is optional content, not the critical path.
The villagers can fear the party and still accept help.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "This is what mercy opened: homes, not a hideout. Let the place answer before anyone lectures. You see families, old injuries, repurposed company gear, and a memory wall of names."

sections.title: State controls
items: bramble_outcome Bramble outcome select unresolved killed captured spared negotiated escaped Only use this map for mercy/trust outcomes.
bramble_truth_learned Bramble truth learned checkbox Set when the community's story lands.
